integrity: Same-model proof review and reproducibility checks only; no external or independent mathematical audit. The finite certificate does not substitute for the analytic all-period proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to rectangular lattice period quotients with m,n >= 5, and to the infinite planar tiling for the stated comparison. Depends on the published general Cayley 1-factorization and Goldberg-Seymour multigraph coloring theorems. Claims neither the 21-neighbor tiling classification nor the known infinite contact-graph isomorphism as new. Historical priority among unindexed toroidal colorings is not definitively established.
title: Exact parity law for contact colorings of extremal triangular tilings on flat tori
